ops.text: 我将为您设计一个面向东南亚的高可用电商架构，使用 ESA 加速、ALB 负载均衡和双可用区部署应对大促流量。

ops.why: 每天约3万用户，大促期间流量激增。

ops.why: 跨双可用区分发 HTTP/HTTPS 流量。

ops.label: Web 应用防火墙
ops.why: 防御 SQL 注入、CC 攻击和恶意爬虫。

ops.label: Web 应用服务器
ops.why: 运行电商核心业务，双可用区高可用部署。

ops.label: 弹性伸缩
ops.why: 大促期间根据 CPU 自动扩容 ECS 实例。

ops.why: 集中收集应用日志并设置告警。

turns.summary: Designed a ride-hailing backend in Jakarta (region: jkt) to keep customer data local. Selected Serverless App Engine (SAE) for 8 microservices (auth, rider, driver, ride, dispatch, fare, payment, notify) across two zones, explicitly avoiding Kubernetes as requested. Architecture includes Cloud-native API Gateway with WAF, RDS for relational data, and Tair for caching. Added VPC, NAT for outbound access, DNS/ESA for routing, and SLS/ARMS for observability. Mobile apps for riders and drivers connect via edge. All components deployed in zones A and B for high availability. No open questions; requirements met.

turns.summary: The ride-hailing backend is designed in Jakarta to keep customer data local and avoid Kubernetes. Serverless App Engine (SAE) hosts eight microservices: auth, user, ride, driver, fare, payment, notification, and rating. A Cloud-Native API Gateway fronts these services, with ESA handling edge traffic. Data persistence uses RDS for relational storage and Tair for caching. SMQ enables async messaging between services, while SLS manages logs. The architecture spans zones a and b within a VPC, connecting mobile apps via DNS and the gateway. No open questions remain regarding the core component selection.
